body: Rebuilt the general Emily training corpus (327 -> 1228 records) so it reflects golden-docs-index.md growth since the 2026-06-14 baseline, including the six newly-registered HQ-SPEC docs (098-103). corpus_stats.py: clean (1 dup, 1 short record). Refreshed var/perplexity-baseline.json using identical eval settings (eval_frac=0.05, batch=1, max_length=64, seed=42, --memory-efficient): 116.76 -> 166.56 PPL. This is an expected rise (larger, more specialized corpus is further out-of-distribution for base GPT-2), not a regression -- old baseline preserved in a history array for comparison. Post-fine-tune target unchanged: PPL < 60 on the same eval set.
title: S146-06: Track A corpus rebuild + perplexity baseline refresh
